jobs.description:
In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next!At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible.

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for a project manager who will be responsible for leading enterprise software implementation and technology transformation projects across a client organization, with an initial focus on the implementation of a Human Resources Information System (HRIS). This role manages the full project lifecycle, including planning, requirements gathering, vendor coordination, system implementation, data migration, testing, training, organizational change management, deployment, and post-implementation support.

  
  

The successful candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, Information Technology, vendors, consultants, and executive leadership to deliver technology solutions that improve operational efficiency, data quality, user experience, and business performance. While the initial assignment will focus on the HRIS implementation, the role may lead additional enterprise software implementations and business transformation projects as organizational priorities evolve.

  
  

This is a client-facing technical role, and does not support development or implementation of internal facing Parsons IT systems.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Project Leadership**

* Lead enterprise software implementation projects from initiation through production deployment, stabilization, and transition to operational support.
* Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, budgets, resource plans, risk registers, issue logs, decision logs, and status reports.
* Manage project scope, timelines, deliverables, dependencies, and stakeholder expectations.
* Facilitate project meetings, steering committee meetings, workshops, and executive briefings.
* Monitor and communicate project status, risks, issues, decisions, and mitigation strategies.

**HRIS Implementation**

* Lead the implementation of the organization’s Human Resources Information System.

jobs.title: AI Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
AI Operations | Managed AI Services | Full-Time, Exempt
  
ECI is seeking an AI Operations Analyst to serve as the operational front door for AI across its client base. This role helps clients adopt, operate, govern, and expand their use of approved enterprise AI platforms while ensuring each request is connected to the right technical guidance, governance path, and service engagement.
  
  
About ECI
  
ECI is building a dedicated AI Operations capability to help regulated organizations operate AI successfully and responsibly at scale. The AI Operations Analyst will work alongside engineers, governance specialists, adoption consultants, business development, and client-facing teams while helping shape ECI's managed AI operations discipline.
  
Position Summary
  
The AI Operations Analyst owns AI-related requests from intake through outcome confirmation, coordinating work across internal teams and maintaining clear client communication. The role combines technical support, client advisory, use-case discovery, governance awareness, and service coordination. Success requires understanding the business need behind each request, translating technical concepts into practical guidance, and engaging the appropriate specialists when broader value or deeper expertise is required.
  
Key Responsibilities
  

* Serve as the primary intake point for AI-related incidents, requests, advisory questions, changes, and operational needs, maintaining ownership through confirmed resolution or outcome.
* Classify, prioritize, document, and coordinate work through established service-management processes and provide proactive communication to clients and internal stakeholders.
* Provide operational support for Microsoft 365 Copilot, Anthropic Claude Enterprise, OpenAI ChatGPT Enterprise, Copilot Studio, approved agents and connectors, and future approved AI platforms.
* Support licensing, entitlements, user access, group membership, troubleshooting, configuration validation, feature guidance, prompt assistance, and agent triage.
* Determine when a request can be resolved through a standard procedure and when AI Engineering, Security Operations, Infrastructure, AI Deployment, AI Adoption, AI Governance, or another specialist team should be engaged.
* Engage clients to understand the business objective behind technical requests and connect needs to relevant AI use cases, productivity goals, adoption requirements, and operational outcomes.
* Provide guidance on documented platform capabilities, limitations, and best practices, and participate in discovery discussions when technical context is needed.
* Recognize opportunities for AI Adoption, AI Governance, AI Engineering, AI Deployment, managed AI services, or related project work, and introduce the appropriate ECI leader or delivery specialist.
* Identify data protection, responsible AI, security, compliance, shadow AI, prompt-injection, and data-exposure concerns and route them through the correct escalation process.
* Maintain knowledge articles, runbooks, and standard operating procedures; track recurring support patterns and release impacts; and recommend automation, self-service, and service improvements.

Required Qualifications
  

* Three to seven years of experience in technical account management, customer success engineering, managed services operations, solutions engineering, Microsoft 365 administration, IT service delivery, SaaS support, or enterprise technical support.
* Demonstrated success in a client-facing technical role and experience using an IT service-management platform such as ServiceNow.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365, including Copilot, Teams, SharePoint Online, Exchange Online, and Microsoft Entra ID.
* Familiarity with enterprise AI platforms, SaaS administration, licensing, single sign-on, SCIM, conditional access, and ITIL service-management concepts.
* Foundational understanding of AI governance, responsible AI, data protection, security, and operational risk.
* Ability to translate technical concepts into business language, uncover requirements through discovery conversations, and coordinate effectively across technical and client-facing teams.
* Excellent written communication, documentation, analytical, escalation-management, and knowledge-authoring skills.

Preferred Qualifications
  

* Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert (MS-102), Microsoft Azure AI Fundamentals (AI-900), or ITIL 4 Foundation certification.
* Experience with Claude Enterprise, ChatGPT Enterprise, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Purview, Defender for Cloud Apps, or Microsoft Power Platform.
* Exposure to AI governance frameworks or responsible AI programs.
* Experience supporting financial services or another regulated industry.

ECI’s culture is all about connection - connection with our clients, our technology and most importantly with each other. In addition to working with an amazing team around the world, ECI also offers a competitive compensation package and the base salary for this role is $125,000 plus flexible PTO, health benefit eligibility the first of the month, life insurance, pet insurance, 401K and so much more! If you believe you’d be a great fit and are ready for your best job ever, we’d like to hear from you!!
  
Love Your Job, Share Your Technology Passion, Create Your Future Here!
  
ECI is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration consistent with applicable law.

DJS Headquarters – Information Technology Unit (Baltimore City)

Baltimore, MD

**Main Purpose of Job**
-----------------------

**Join Us in Making a Difference at DJS!**  
  

The Maryland Department of Juvenile Services (DJS) is dedicated to transforming young lives, creating safer communities, and fostering equitable systems. We are seeking passionate individuals for the role of **Security and Privacy Officer (Administrative Program Manager IV)**, so come join our team and make a meaningful impact on our youth and the staff community at DJS!  
  

The **Security and Privacy Officer** serves as the dedicated cybersecurity and privacy lead for DJS. Reporting directly to the Chief Information Officer (CIO), this position provides day-to-day security engagement with DJS’s infrastructure, platforms, and internal operations. The role functions as DJS’s empowered Information Security Officer and designated Agency Privacy Officer (APO), ensuring the department meets its cybersecurity and privacy obligations distinct from the Office of Security Management’s (OSM) statewide mandate. As the designated APO, the role performs privacy functions to support DJS’s privacy risk management framework.

  

*In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute in various ways, including:*

  

* *Agency Security Operations and Engagement* – Serving as the primary day-to-day cybersecurity point of contact for DJS divisions, including Platform and Client Services, Infrastructure, and Digital Experience, by providing security guidance, risk advisories, and operational support; conducting security assessments of systems, infrastructure, and applications; reviewing projects and procurements for security requirements; monitoring security metrics and reporting on security posture, incident trends, and remediation progress; and coordinating with OSM’s Cyber Technology Directorate to support the adoption and effective use of centralized cybersecurity platforms and services
  

  

* *Privacy Officer Functions* – Serving as the designated Agency Privacy Officer (APO) for the Department of Information Technology; developing and maintaining DJS-specific privacy policies, procedures, and standards aligned with statewide frameworks; conducting Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs) for systems, applications, and data use and sharing arrangements involving personally identifiable information (PII) or Personal Information (PI); coordinating privacy incident response and breach notification obligations; and advising leadership on data minimization, retention, and disposal practices
  

  

* *Cybersecurity Agency Compliance and Risk Management* – Managing DJS’s cybersecurity compliance with applicable frameworks, including the NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF), NIST SP 800-53, and Maryland statewide security policies; maintaining a DJS-specific risk register, tracking risk treatment plans and remediation timelines in coordination with OSM’s Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) functions, and reporting status to the State CISO; aligning internal compliance activities with statewide audit and assessment cycles; coordinating responses to cybersecurity and privacy findings; and maintaining clear accountability between this position’s cybersecurity and privacy compliance responsibilities and the DJS Compliance Officer’s IT, financial, and performance compliance responsibilities
  

  

* *Coordination, Governance Participation, and Program Support* – Representing DJS on statewide governance boards, such as the Cyber Security Coordinating Council; collaborating with OSM directorates, including Cyber Technology, Cyber Resilience, GRC, State Privacy, and State and Local Cybersecurity, to integrate DJS-specific security and privacy activities into the statewide program; and supporting the CIO with analysis, briefing materials, and situational awareness on security and privacy matters for executive leadership reporting
  

  

* *Other Duties as Assigned* – Performing other duties as assigned by the Chief Information Officer

--------------------------

**Experience:** Five (5) years of professional experience performing information security, cybersecurity risk assessment, security compliance monitoring, privacy risk management, or information technology risk and compliance activities.  
  

**Note:** Candidates may substitute a Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in information technology, cybersecurity, computer science, information systems, or a closely related field for three (3) years of the required experience.

**DESIRED OR PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
---------------------------------------

* Experience applying cybersecurity frameworks and standards to security assessments, risk mitigation, and compliance activities, preferably in a public-sector or government environment
* Experience supporting or implementing privacy program activities, including privacy assessments, privacy incident response, data protection practices, or the development and maintenance of privacy policies and procedures
* Possess any relevant professional certifications or specialized training in cybersecurity, information security, or privacy, or risk management

Since 2012, we've been helping organizations outpace evolving attacks with faster response, fewer escalations, and measurable risk reduction.

Innovation isn't just a buzzword here; it's our DNA. We pioneered the first MOBILESOC app for on-the-go detection and response, infused AI into automated alert resolution to eliminate noise, and slashed investigation time by an astounding 99.3%. jobs.title: Cyber Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
##### **About Peraton**

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

##### **About The Role**

**Position Summary**

  

The Lead Cyber Intelligence Analyst manages the end-to-end production lifecycle of multi-source technical cyber intelligence, ensuring compliance with Intelligence Community (IC) analytic tradecraft standards and the timely dissemination of actionable assessments to Department of Energy (DOE) stakeholders. This role integrates technical cyber threat intelligence and other authorized intelligence sources to produce accurate, defensible, and mission-relevant assessments that inform threat prioritization, risk management, and defensive operations.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage the full intelligence production lifecycle, including requirements, analysis, drafting, quality assurance, review, approval, and dissemination.
* Integrate multi-source technical cyber intelligence to assess adversary capabilities, tactics, techniques, procedures (TTPs), targeting, and potential impacts to DOE missions and critical infrastructure.
* Ensure intelligence products adhere to applicable IC analytic standards, including rigorous sourcing, analytic objectivity, confidence statements, and clear communication of uncertainty.
* Coordinate with intelligence, cybersecurity, and mission stakeholders to prioritize requirements, validate findings, and deliver timely, actionable assessments.
* Develop and disseminate intelligence reports, threat assessments, briefings, and warning products tailored to technical and executive audiences.
* Lead production workflows, mentor analysts, enforce quality control, and identify opportunities to improve analytic rigor, efficiency, and stakeholder support.

##### **Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**

* Minimum of 8 years with BS/BA; Minimum of 6 years with MS/MA; Minimum of 3 years with PhD, 12 years with a HS Diploma
* Demonstrated experience in cyber intelligence analysis, intelligence production, or a related cybersecurity or national security discipline.
* Experience managing intelligence products from initial requirements through final dissemination.
* Knowledge of IC analytic tradecraft standards, structured analytic techniques, and multi-source intelligence integration.
* Strong understanding of cyber threats, adversary TTPs, vulnerabilities, and technical threat analysis.
* Excellent analytical writing, communication, coordination, and leadership skills.
* Ability to handle sensitive and classified information in accordance with applicable security requirements.
* US Citizen with the ability to obtain a Dept of Energy clearance

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting DOE, the Intelligence Community, or critical infrastructure cybersecurity.
* Familiarity with industrial control systems (ICS), operational technology (OT), and energy-sector cyber threats.
* Relevant technical certifications, advanced education, and experience in classified intelligence environments.

##### **Details**

**Target Salary Range:** $104,000 - $166,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

**Benefits Statement:** Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

**Application Statements:** The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate’s own.

**EEO:** Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

jobs.title: Global Mobility Program Manager, Tax
jobs.description:

#### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience supporting a defense, aerospace, or other highly regulated industry, including how export control and clearance requirements affect mobility decisions.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager: Software & Data Platform
jobs.description:
**About the Role**  
ANDECO is building a data platform for a federal customer. A subcontractor will do most of the engineering. ANDECO owns the program, accepts the deliverables, and maintains the platform after delivery. The Technical Project Manager makes sure the right work gets done on schedule. You will sit between ANDECO leadership and the subcontractor's engineers, track execution against milestones, test reported progress against working software, and keep leadership informed.

The initial requirements and milestones are already defined, so your early focus is execution: keeping the subcontractor on plan and catching problems early. As the platform matures, you will take a larger role in its design, writing user stories and building requirements for later phases. This is a technical role. You need enough depth to question engineering decisions, and the judgment to turn that detail into short assessments that nontechnical leaders can act on.

**Manage delivery against the plan**

* Track subcontractor work against the approved project plan, milestones, deliverables, and demonstration schedule, and hold the subcontractor to them.
* Maintain the schedule, risk register, and decision log. Catch schedule and cost slips early and bring leadership options before a problem becomes a surprise.
* Run change control so that changes to requirements, architecture, schedule, cost, or deliverables are surfaced, priced, and approved before work proceeds.
* Own the acceptance test plan. Define the tests and demonstrations each milestone must pass, run or witness them, and recommend acceptance or rejection to ANDECO leadership.
* Confirm that source code, build instructions, infrastructure code, and documentation are deposited with ANDECO at each milestone, and that they are complete enough for another team to build and run the platform.
* Keep a productive working relationship with the subcontractor while holding it to ANDECO's requirements.
* Make sure ANDECO receives the documentation, tests, and handoff materials it needs to maintain the platform after delivery.

**Evaluate technical work**

* Take part in architecture discussions, design reviews, demonstrations, and sprint reviews.
* Test reported progress against working software, test results, and documentation, and challenge estimates and technical approaches the evidence does not support.
* Judge whether the implementation meets approved requirements and security constraints, and flag integration problems and deployment blockers.
* Make sure changes to the data model and ontology are reviewed and approved by ANDECO before the subcontractor builds on them.
* Make sure testing, documentation, and security get attention alongside feature completion.

**Shape requirements as the platform evolves**

* Write user stories and acceptance criteria, and keep requirements traceable to deliverables, testing, and acceptance.
* Prioritize the backlog with ANDECO leadership and engineers.
* Contribute to design decisions and later phase requirements as the project moves beyond its initial plan.

**Brief Leadership**

* Give senior executives short assessments of progress, risk, cost, schedule, and subcontractor performance, along with the decisions coming due.
* Translate technical issues into business and program consequences for nontechnical decision makers.
* Create the dashboards and slide decks that executives rely on to make decisions.
* Distinguish completed, tested work from work still in progress.

**Coordinate across teams**

* Serve as the coordination point among ANDECO leadership, engineers, analysts, government sponsors, and the subcontractor.
* Set the meeting and reporting rhythm for technical reviews and risk management, and keep the paperwork light for engineers.
* Follow ANDECO processes and recommend improvements where they would help.
* Use ANDECO provided AI tools in your daily work and help the team put them to use.

**Required Qualifications**

* At least 6 years of experience, including managing software or data development projects from requirements through delivery.
* Experience overseeing subcontractors, vendors, or other external engineering teams.
* Experience accepting deliveries from an external engineering team, including checking that the delivered code can be built and deployed by someone else.
* Technical depth in software and data architecture, APIs, and cloud infrastructure, enough to evaluate engineering work and question its assumptions. *Project management experience alone is not sufficient for this role.*
* Experience writing user stories, requirements, milestones, and acceptance criteria, and managing scope, schedule, and risk.
* Experience judging progress from demonstrations, technical artifacts, and test results, and willingness to push back on reported status the evidence does not support.
* Ability to explain complex technical issues to senior leaders and nontechnical stakeholders, in writing and in person.
* Experience using AI tools in professional work, and willingness to adopt ANDECO provided AI tools.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or Business Administration.
* *U.S. citizenship and the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance.*
* Employment is contingent on a successful preemployment background check.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Systems Engineering, or an MBA.
* Active security clearance.
* Experience on software or data platform projects for the Department of Defense, the Intelligence Community, Special Operations, or other U.S. Government missions.
* Experience on subcontracted development where the prime organization keeps technical and program accountability.
* Experience with Agile, Scrum, Kanban, or similar iterative methods, including backlog management.

**About the Milken Institute**

The Milken Institute is a globally minded, publicly supported, non-partisan, and nonprofit think tank headquartered in Santa Monica, with offices in Washington, DC, New York, London, Abu Dhabi, and Singapore. For the past three decades, the Milken Institute has served as a catalyst for practical, scalable solutions to global challenges by connecting human, financial, and educational resources to those who need them. Guided by a conviction that the best ideas, under-resourced, cannot succeed, we conduct research and analysis and convene top experts, innovators, and influencers from different backgrounds and competing viewpoints. We leverage this expertise and insight to construct programs and policy initiatives. These activities are designed to help people build meaningful lives, in which they can experience health and well-being, pursue effective education and gainful employment, and access the resources required to create ever-expanding opportunities for themselves and their broader communities.

The Milken Institute’s events and programmatic activities, involve the exchange of ideas with leaders from around the world. The Institute hosts more than 200 events each year, with our annual flagship event, Global Conference, bringing together 4,500+ participants from around the world, featuring more than 900+ speakers throughout 200+ sessions over the course of the event.

**About The Position**

The Milken Institute is seeking a highly organized, analytical, and detail-oriented Senior Associate, Business Analyst to join the Project and Portfolio Management Office (PPMO) within the Technology Department. This role reports to the Product Manager, CRM & Data Analytics and supports the delivery, enhancement, and ongoing optimization of enterprise technology solutions, with a primary focus on Salesforce and related data analytics platforms.

The Business Analyst serves as a liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating business needs into clear, actionable requirements and supporting the delivery of technology solutions that align with the Institute's operational objectives.

This is a hands-on role that combines business analysis, project coordination, and Agile delivery support. The Senior Associate will independently coordinate enhancement requests, to serve our operations teams, while supporting larger CRM and data analytics initiatives under the direction of the Product Manager.

Key responsibilities include gathering and documenting business requirements, developing process maps and functional specifications, creating test cases and coordinating user acceptance testing, maintaining Jira boards and facilitating Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning and backlog refinement.

Working closely with the Product Manager, business stakeholders, internal Technology teams, and external vendors, the Business Analyst will help ensure that requirements are clearly defined, work is appropriately tracked, and delivered solutions meet agreed-upon business needs.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, and analytical, with strong communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills. The Senior Associate will collaborate with colleagues across Business Development, Events, Marketing, Operations, Programming, and other departments throughout the Institute.

The successful Business Analyst will maintain organized and accurate Jira boards, facilitate effective Agile ceremonies, support sprint execution, and ensure that system enhancements are validated against documented requirements through structured testing and business acceptance.

Over time, the Senior Associate will develop a deeper understanding of the Institute's Salesforce ecosystem, business processes, data structures, and enterprise technology standards. As their skills grow, they will take on increasingly complex enhancements, contribute recommendations for process improvements, and strengthen the efficiency and consistency of CRM and data analytics delivery.

Translate business needs into user stories, acceptance criteria, functional specifications, and process maps that can be understood by technical and non-technical audiences.
* Enhancement Request Management: Independently coordinate technology enhancement requests, primarily supporting Business Development and Events. Manage assigned requests from requirements gathering through implementation, testing, and business acceptance, including tracking scope, timelines, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder communications. Escalate changes or issues requiring Product Manager review.
* Agile and Scrum Facilitation: Serve as Scrum Master for assigned initiatives, facilitating sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and other Agile ceremonies. Support the Product Manager in maintaining an organized, prioritized, and actionable product backlog.

jobs.description:
**Position Summary:**

HunaTek is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Operations Research Analyst to join our dynamic team in the defense sector. The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in decision support techniques, data collection, analytics, and reporting, with a focus on meeting client requirements. As an Operations Research Analyst, you will be responsible for analyzing datasets provided by Department of Defense (DoD) customers, identifying trends and anomalies, and utilizing this information for forecasting purposes.

If you are passionate about leveraging data to support critical decision-making in the defense market and possess the necessary skills and qualifications, we invite you to apply for this exciting opportunity. Join us in making a meaningful impact on the future of defense operations and strategic planning.

**Essential Job Functions:**

* Decision Support Analysis:
  + Support and/or lead Business Case Analysis (BCA) and Economic Analysis (EA) studies.
  + Lead stakeholder engagement and study scoping efforts.
  + Lead, develop, update, and apply mathematical and logical methodologies for estimating program benefits, costs, and risks.
  + Lead, develop, update, manipulate, and maintain cost and affordability models.
  + Lead efforts in collecting, normalizing, and analyzing complex data.
  + Evaluate program investment and acquisition strategies and courses of action.
  + Conduct planning for acquisition of capabilities.
* Data Collection and Analysis:
  + Collect, process, and analyze complex datasets provided by DoD customers to extract meaningful insights.
  + Utilize statistical methods, modeling techniques, and optimization algorithms to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies.
* Client Interfacing:
  + Work closely with clients to understand their operational needs and requirements.
  + Develop tailored analytics and reporting solutions to meet specific client demands and enhance decision-making processes.
* Forecasting:
  + Utilize advanced forecasting models to predict future trends and outcomes based on historical data and current inputs.
  + Provide accurate and timely forecasts to assist clients in strategic planning and resource allocations.
* Department of Defense Knowledge: Possess a strong knowledge base in Department of Defense operations, policies, and procedures.
  + Stay informed about the latest developments and changes within the DoD to ensure analyses align with current defense priorities.
* DoD Acquisition Programs:
  + Demonstrate experience and familiarity with DoD Acquisition programs and processes.
  + Apply expertise to assess and optimize acquisition strategies, resource allocation, and program management.
* Support on-site delivery in the Quantico and Stafford areas.

**Skills and Qualification Required:**

* US Citizenship required.
* Active Secret Security Clearance or ability to obtain a Secret Security Clearance.
* Problem Solving and Analytical Skills - Ability to identify problems, analyze data, and develop effective solutions.
* Mathematical & Statistical Knowledge - Proficiency in data analysis tools and techniques such as Python, R, or similar languages.
* Communication Skills - Strong communication skills with the ability to convey complex analytical results to non-technical stakeholders.
* Collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively in a team-oriented environment.

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor's or advanced degree in Operations Research, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related field.
* Proven experience in data analysis, statistical modeling, and forecasting, with a focus on defense-related datasets.
* Experience supporting BCAs, AoAs, EA or other analytical studies.

* Experience with data visualization tools and techniques to effectively communicate findings.

At HunaTek, we build teams of people from all backgrounds with varying levels of experience, knowing firsthand that diversity of thought will strengthen our ability to deliver for our customers. We work hand in hand with Federal civilian and military staff, pulling together to further the interests of our nation and home and abroad.

Whenever possible, we provide opportunities for our employees to learn new skills, obtain certifications, attend industry events, and have some fun together.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to make sure our employees and their families have access to good health care, are insured against catastrophic health events, can put money aside for retirement and are able to maintain a healthy work-life balance. These benefits include:

* Comprehensive medical, dental and vision
* Long-term and short-term disability insurance and term life insurance

This position is located in the Office of the Director, under the Chief Data Officer. The role carries primary responsibility for collecting, managing, analyzing, and interpreting data to support evidence‑based decision‑making across assigned program areas. The incumbent utilizes multiple databases to generate program reports, ensure data integrity, and retrieve historical information for summary reports, ad hoc analyses, and requests for information. The position develops analytical approaches and prepares reports on performance measures, goals, milestones, trends, and program improvements. This includes compiling trend data for required quarterly reporting and participating in management reviews of data findings. The analyst provides guidance and support for data‑sharing initiatives with internal and external stakeholders, while applying analytical techniques to enhance data processing, reporting, and query capabilities.

The incumbent also captures, develops, and documents data definitions, rules, quality requirements, and data models in alignment with program needs. Responsibilities include performing data cleaning, validation, and verification; determining the most effective methods for data collection; and independently obtaining necessary data. The analyst applies quantitative and qualitative techniques to support grant and research reporting requirements, as well as development of value‑added intelligence products. The position ensures the quality of all deliverables, including processes, procedures, data extracts, reports, audit logs, and compliance with reporting standards.

jobs.title: Engagement and Program Manager - Wealth / Asset Management
jobs.description:
*Please do not contact us or apply if you are a recruiter, consultant or outsourcing company.*

**Deliver with focus. Scale with intent**

Are you a delivery leader who knows how to guide large customers through complex set-ups without over-engineering the journey? Do you care deeply about building scalable, repeatable SaaS delivery rather than one-off custom projects?  
  
At Performativ, we’re building the infrastructure layer for modern wealth management. As our Engagement and Program Manager, you’ll lead the rollout of our SaaS platform for our largest customers, successfully onboarding them through structured delivery, clear communication, and lightweight technical engagement.  
  
This is not a professional services consulting role. You won’t be buried in endless customer-specific code or heavy customizations. Instead, you’ll work cross-functionally to help customers adopt our product the right way: cleanly, securely, and in line with platform best practices so they can scale on top of us, not around us.

**What you will do**

* Own enterprise set-up programs end to end (kick-off through to go-live and hyper-care) against an agreed plan and scope (Statement of Work).
* Interrogate and determine how customer requirements are and describe how they can be addressed in the platform.
* Enable customers to integrate Performativ via standard platform patterns (APIs, SSO, configuration) without custom buildouts, working with product and engineering to flag gaps early and advocate for scalable paths.
* Own plan, scope, and change control, keeping scope tied to contract and change visible and decided rather than quietly absorbed, and support the Technical Program Lead on requirements, design documents, and acceptance-criteria sign-off.
* Run customer communication, cadence, and governance with reporting that keeps meetings short, and manage risk, dependency, and issue tracking (including customer-side).
* Lead a clean handover to Customer Success at go-live or hyper-care exit, including train-the-trainer sessions and supporting materials.
* Represent the program in internal capacity and exception reviews, bringing requests the plan cannot absorb back as options rather than committing on the spot.
* Build repeatable playbooks, documentation, and artefacts that make the next program faster. You will be measured on this, not only on your own delivery.

**How you will work**

You will run multiple programs at once, in a delivery pod alongside the Technical Program Lead, Integration Engineers, Data Migration Specialists, and Product Engineers. None report to you. Rather you get things done through clarity and relationships, not authority. You will report to the COO. The role is remote with travel 40% of the time – both to customer site and to our head-office in Copenhagen - expected as a minimum.

**What we're looking for**

* 7+ years in program or engagement management, consulting, product management, or another delivery-facing role, with a track record of leading complex, multi-stakeholder implementations end to end.
* Experience in either wealth management, private banking and / or asset management is a pre-requisite experience.
* Comfortable being firm with customers on scope and timeline while keeping the relationship stronger for it.
* Structured and highly organized, producing written plans, governance cadences, and reporting that stakeholders can act on.
* Broad technical literacy across enterprise SaaS delivery: API-based integrations, SSO and security configuration, and data migration and mapping, including enough SQL to read and question a mapping. You do not build the integration, but you understand it well enough to scope it, question it, and know when something does not add up.
* Ability to build working fluency in the customer's business domain fast: within 90 days, able to discuss topics such as advice and suitability workflows and customer reporting without a subject-matter expert in the room.
* ITIL Foundation, PMP, PRINCE2 Certification (or equivalent) would be beneficial but not required.

**Technical Fluency**

* You’re not, necessarily, a developer, but you’re comfortable with APIs, data structures, auth flows (OAuth/SAML), and deployment models.
* You can dive into logs, payloads, and basic SQL or Python when needed to unblock yourself or a customer - but you prioritize scalable fixes over tactical workarounds.
* You advocate for platform-aligned solutions, not special cases.

**What this role is not**

This role sits in operations, not engineering or commercial, and is project-based: once delivery is complete, you roll on to the next engagement. As a SaaS provider, we do not build bespoke software; delivery works within the bounds of the product.

**We can offer :**

* Trust and responsibility to shape how Performativ delivers for its largest customers.
* A competitive salary and benefits package.
* A fast-growing, VC-backed fintech scaleup, working alongside professionals from leading institutions (Goldman Sachs, McKinsey, BCG, Amazon and others).
* Career acceleration through professional development and leadership opportunities.

**SUMMARY**

The Community Safety Crisis and Incident Response Through Community-Led Engagement (C.I.R.C.L.E.) program is a 24/7 unarmed response program that deploys a team of mental health professionals and individuals with lived experience to address non-violent LAPD calls related to unhoused individuals experiencing crisis. Through this public health approach, the City is able to improve community safety and outcomes for Angelenos in need of social services and support. The goals of the program are to: (1) disrupt the reciprocal relationship between homelessness and the criminal justice system by promptly responding to diverted non-violent incidents related to persons experiencing homelessness (PEH); (2) de-escalate and stabilize incidents involving unhoused individuals; and (3) create enduring positive outcomes for those individuals through trauma informed rapport building, connections to services and resources, and case management.

The Assistant Program Manager provides direct support to the Program Manager to ensure the smooth functioning of program activities. The APM is responsible for partnering with the Program Manager to ensure 1.) CIRCLE Operations are running smoothly and ample coverage is scheduled 2.) **Your Mission**
================

As part of the **Finance Technology** team, you will act as a **business partner to Finance and Business stakeholders**, with the ability to understand the underlying business objective, challenge existing ways of working, identify opportunities for simplification and automation, and translate business needs into efficient, scalable processes and system solutions.

Your role covers the **end-to-end O2C landscape**, from commercial and contract information through billing, revenue, collections and treasury, across applications including Salesforce, Workday Financials, Workday PSA, IonBiz, Sidetrade and Kyriba.

You will work at the **intersection of Business, Finance and IS**, ensuring that technology enables the right business processes rather than simply reproducing existing ways of working.

**We are not looking for a Workday specialist**. The ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in Order-to-Cash, Finance transformation, ERP or business applications, combined with the ability to understand and navigate a complex multi-system environment. Knowledge of Workday is a strong advantage, but a strong O2C / Finance Systems profile with experience on other ERP or enterprise platforms will also be considered.

Responsibilities:

**1. Act as a Business Partner for Order-to-Cash**

* Develop a strong understanding of the company's business model, Finance processes and end-to-end O2C operating model.
* Partner with Finance, Sales and Business Operations stakeholders to understand their objectives, challenges and pain points.
* **Challenge existing processes, requirements and assumptions**, rather than simply translating them into system specifications.
* Ask the right questions to distinguish between a genuine business need, an existing practice and a historical system limitation.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate and improve processes.
* Recommend pragmatic solutions that balance business value, user experience, scalability and technical constraints.
* Help stakeholders move from a **“what we do today”** mindset to a **“what should the target process be?”**

jobs.description:
**Description de l’entreprise**
-------------------------------

  
  

Institution financière internationale de premier plan, Natixis Corporate & Investment Banking met à disposition des entreprises, institutions financières, fonds d’investissement, agences souverains et supranationaux une palette de services en conseil, investment banking, financements, banque commerciale et sur les marchés de capitaux.

Ses équipes d’experts, présentes dans environ 30 pays, conseillent les clients sur leur développement stratégique en les accompagnant dans le développement et la transformation de leurs activités tout en maximisant leur impact positif. Natixis CIB s’engage sur un alignement de son portefeuille de financements sur une trajectoire de neutralité carbone d’ici 2050 tout en aidant ses clients à réduire l’impact environnemental de leur activité.

Natixis CIB fait partie du Groupe BPCE, deuxième groupe bancaire en France à travers les réseaux Banque Populaire et Caisse d’Epargne. Elle bénéficie de la puissance financière et des solides notations du Groupe (Standard & Poor's : A+, Moody's : A2, Fitch Ratings: A+, R&I : A+).

  
  

**Poste et missions**
---------------------

  
  

Vous rejoindrez notre équipe Oversight, Quality & Controls , composée de 8 personnes, au sein du département Global Markets Operations, qui recherche un **Data Analyst** pour un stage de **6 mois** à partir de **novembre 2026.** Le secteur OQC est des secteurs du département Global Markets Operations, qui regroupe les activités post-marchés (Trade support, middle et back office). Il est entre autres le correspondant des auditeurs internes (Inspections, Compliance et direction des risques opérationnels) et des régulateurs, en charge de la qualité de données GMO et responsable du datalake des indicateurs GMO.

En collaboration avec votre tuteur, vos missions principales seront :

**Data Quality Framework :**

* Identifier, documenter et surveiller la production de chaque donnée, de manière à couvrir et suivre le processus depuis sa création, transformation jusqu’à son stockage ;
* Identifier les données critiques pour l'activité du métier à travers une collaboration avec business owners du département ;
* Documenter et remonter de potentiels problèmes de qualité ;
* Proposer et suivre des plans de remédiation ;
* Participer à l’acculturation des parties prenantes.
  

**Data preparation et data visualization:**

* Identifier les données pertinentes et les golden sources au sein d’un datalake;
* Participer à des ateliers d'idéation pour la création de modèles de données;
* Développer, automatiser et maintenir les Data Quality contrôles sur Informatica ;
* Réaliser une première analyse pour détecter les anomalies liées à qualité de donnée ;
* Maintenir des Dashboards de Data Quality sur Power BI.
  

**Participation à d'autres projets data au sein de GMO**

* Mise en qualité des données stockées dans le Datalake;
* Tests techniques et fonctionnels sur des évolutions IT du modèle de données (algorithmique python, exploration de données sur PBI existants).
  

Outils et langages utilisés : Excel, Informatica, IGraphx, SQL, Zeenea, Power BI, Python.

**#FinanceTransformative**

Vous évoluez dans un environnement international et inclusif, favorisant le collaboratif avec des missions concrètes et un impact réel. Nous vous accompagnerons tout au long de votre expérience chez nous pour que vous puissiez apprendre et développer vos compétences en travaillant aux côtés de professionnels expérimentés.

Vous avez également la possibilité de vous engager en faveur de la société et de causes qui vous tiennent à cœur via notre fondation d’entreprise.

En plus d’une indemnité de stage attractive calculée en fonction de votre formation et de votre niveau d’études, vous bénéficiez du remboursement de votre titre de transport à hauteur de 60 %, d’un jour d’absence autorisé payé pour chaque mois travaillé et de l’accès au restaurant de l’entreprise.

Vous pourrez également avoir accès au comité d’entreprise.

  
  

**Profil et compétences requises**
----------------------------------

  
  

Étudiant de niveau Bac+4/5, vous préparez un diplôme (universitaire, d’école de commerce ou d’école d’ingénieur), avec une spécialisation en Data et gestion de projet. Vous êtes reconnu pour vos bonnes compétences analytiques, votre méthode et votre rigueur. Vous avez de bonnes capacités en résolution de problèmes et savez les exposer clairement dans des termes non techniques. Vos qualités relationnelles et de communication sont excellentes. Vous savez prendre des initiatives. And last but not least, you are perfectly fluent in English.

jobs.description:
**Description de l'entreprise**

*Veolia, leader mondial des services à l’environnement, participe chaque jour à construire la sécurité environnementale. Présent sur les cinq continents, le groupe dépollue, décarbone et régénère les ressources à travers des solutions concrètes combinant ses expertises dans le domaine de l’eau, des déchets et de l'énergie.*

*Partenaire de nombreux industriels et collectivités, l'Activité Recyclage & Valorisation, entité du groupe Veolia, a pour ambition de devenir le producteur de ressources renouvelables de référence en France. Nous proposons une gamme complète de solutions innovantes à toutes les étapes du cycle des déchets, de leur collecte à leur transformation et valorisation en matière et en énergie, grâce aux étapes de tri et de traitement.*

 **Description du poste**

**VOTRE MISSION**

Rattachée à la Direction Direction Services aux Entreprises, au sein de la filière Commerce, Valorisation et Innovation, l’équipe développe de nouvelles offres B2B pour accompagner les entreprises dans leur transition vers l’économie circulaire.

Acteur de référence de la gestion et de la valorisation des déchets, la DSE évolue dans un marché en pleine transformation, marqué par les évolutions réglementaires, la montée en puissance de l’économie circulaire, la consolidation du secteur et l’évolution des attentes des clients. Pour éclairer ses décisions et soutenir sa conquête de nouvelles parts de marché, l’entreprise crée une équipe Market Intelligence.

**VOS RESPONSABILITÉS :**

**Structurer la fonction et manager l’équipe :**

* Définir la vision, le périmètre et la feuille de route; recruter, encadrer et faire monter en compétences les deux analystes;
* Etablir les processus, méthodologies, référentiels et outils de veille et d’analyse;
* Coordonner les demandes des parties prenantes internes.

**Réaliser des études sectorielles et de marché :**

* Analyser les marchés de la collecte, du tri, du traitement et de la valorisation;
* Etudier les différentes typologies de déchets, filières et zones géographiques;
* Evaluer le potentiel de nouveaux marchés et anticiper les évolutions réglementaires, technologiques et économiques.

**Déployer une veille stratégique et concurrentielle :**

* Suivre les concurrents, clients et prospects, la réglementation, les technologies, les prix, les appels d’offres et les opérations de fusion-acquisition;
* Diffuser des analyses et alertes directement exploitables par les équipes.

**Contribuer à la stratégie commerciale de conquête :**

* Identifier et prioriser les cibles, analyser les appels d’offres et les renouvellements de contrats,
* Elaborer des plans de conquête avec les directions commerciales et fournir des analyses de comptes stratégiques.

**Communiquer et influencer :**

* Présenter les analyses et recommandations à la direction générale et aux comités de direction;
* Adapter les livrables aux besoins des publics et agir comme partenaire stratégique des directions métiers.

  
**Qualifications**

**Niveau de formation :** Bac+5 (école de commerce, école d’ingénieur ou équivalent)

* **Expérience :** 8 à 10 ans en market intelligence, études de marché, conseil en stratégie ou stratégie d’entreprise. Une première expérience en management d’équipe ou en encadrement de projet est indispensable.
* **Expertise :** maîtrise de l’analyse sectorielle, du dimensionnement de marché et de la veille concurrentielle; capacité à exploiter des sources de données variées.
* **Culture commerciale et data :** bonne compréhension des enjeux commerciaux B2B, notamment des appels d’offres et des cycles de vente longs; maîtrise d’Excel avancé et d’outils de visualisation tels que Power BI ou équivalent. Des notions de CRM sont appréciées.
* **Connaissance sectorielle :** une expérience dans les déchets, l’environnement, l’énergie ou les utilities est un atout, mais l’expertise méthodologique prime.
* **Qualités personnelles :** leadership pragmatique, rigueur intellectuelle, esprit critique, orientation résultats, curiosité, autonomie et capacité à travailler en transversalité avec diplomatie.
* **Communication :** excellente capacité de synthèse à l’écrit comme à l’oral, avec une réelle aisance pour convaincre.
* **Langues :** anglais professionnel.

  
**Informations supplémentaires**

**Localisation :** Aubervilliers (périmètre national)

**Type de contrat :** CDI – création de poste

**Expérience** : 8 à 10 ans en market intelligence, études de marché, conseil en stratégie ou stratégie d’entreprise; une première expérience en management d’équipe ou en encadrement de projet est indispensable

**La Direction des Services aux Entreprises (DSE) s'appuie sur un maillage national structuré autour de :**

* **7 territoires**
* **130 agences**
* **45 déchetteries professionnelles**

Ce que Nous Vous Offrons :

Environnement de Travail

* Intégration au sein d'un groupe international de référence dans la transition écologique
* Poste à fort impact stratégique
* Collaboration avec des équipes expertes et pluridisciplinaires
* Environnement de travail innovant

Perspectives d'Évolution

**Avantages :**

* Rémunération attractive + variable sur objectifs
* Mutuelle & prévoyance
* Téléphone & outils digitaux
* Engagement fort pour la transition écologique

En tant qu'entreprise inclusive, Veolia s’engage pour la diversité et accorde la même considération à toutes les candidatures, sans discrimination.

jobs.title: Senior Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the Role**
------------------

Business Operations is Rippling’s strike team for high-stakes, mission-critical challenges. We are the architects behind product development, go-to-market strategies, and scale operations across the entire company. Operating as the connective tissue for our compound startup, this small, elite unit brings structure to massive ambiguity and executes with relentless precision.

We need BizOps Managers who are world-class problem solvers, first-principles thinkers, and fearless operators. You won't just advise, you will build from 0-to-1, tackle the company’s biggest strategic bets, and partner directly with executive leadership. For high-performers, this role is the ultimate launchpad into executive leadership at an ultra-high-growth company.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Hunt Down High-Impact Problems: Identify critical business friction points, step into the fire, and build scalable solutions alongside senior leaders.
* Master the Revenue Engine: Architect and refine monetization, pricing, and packaging strategies to aggressively accelerate market dominance.
* Drive Cross-Functional Force-Multiplier Projects: Partner directly with Product, Engineering, and GTM teams to launch new initiatives and revolutionize operational systems.
* Own Your Data: Dig into raw databases, build custom SQL queries, construct dashboards, and extract actionable insight without needing a safety net.
* Set the Source of Truth: Collaborate with Finance and RevOps to define, standardize, and scale the operational metrics that steer the entire business.

**What You'll Need**
--------------------

* 8+ years of battle-tested experience in top-tier management consulting, BizOps, VC/PE, or as a startup founder. Exceptional talent with fewer years but a proven track record of rapid acceleration will be considered.
* Cross-functional mastery: A deep understanding of organizational dynamics in high-velocity tech environments.
* A data-first instinct: You instinctively open a spreadsheet, code a query, or analyze a dataset before building a slide deck.
* Extreme altitude-switching: Equally comfortable pitching strategy to C-suite executives as you are getting into the weeds with frontline operators.
* Relentless ownership and grit: You don't pass the mic or make excuses—you take full accountability and solve problems permanently.
* High-conviction autonomy: You thrive in chaos, make sound calls with incomplete data, and move fast without waiting for a playbook.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the Role**
------------------

We are hiring a Technical Program Manager to lead high priority safety and security programs which advance defense in depth for agents, which we have written about publicly.

You will be the lead TPM coordinating work across teams to strengthen how we develop and deploy agents safely and securely, and to bring what we build internally to customers and partners so everyone has the tools to safely and securely use Claude. You will be responsible for leading meetings with executives and technical leads, maintaining complex project plans, identifying and addressing risks, developing metrics, and communicating to the company and our customers about this work.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* **Maintain the roadmap** - Maintain and extend the existing roadmap for all work contributing to this effort across the company and implement approaches to ensure accuracy and relevance amidst a fast operational tempo.
* **Turn program goals into measurable exit criteria at each phase of the work** - To do this well you’ll need to be responsive to new developments in capabilities and the threat landscape, both of which are evolving fast. Maintain key metrics and dashboards.
* **Run the operating rhythm** - Chair the leads meetings, working group meetings, design reviews, and executive check-ins. Record decisions and actions, disseminate sitreps quickly and regularly, and follow up until open issues close.
* **Lead executive and contributor communication** - Drive conversations, write regular reports, contribute to design documents, and produce decisional documents as needed. Say plainly what is on track, what is not, and where help is needed.
* **Maintain the risk register** - Track risks, exceptions, and risk acceptances in one place and bring hard calls to the right decision maker.
* **Drive company-wide communications** - Partner with internal communications on progress updates and on rollouts that change how employees work with Claude every day.
* **Lead through other TPMs** - Coordinate subject matter specific TPMs and engineering managers who do not report to you. Set shared standards, spot coverage gaps, and step in to augment capacity where needed.
* **Take coordination load off technical leaders** - Find owners for cross-team problems, frame tradeoffs across Security, Safeguards, Research, Privacy, Legal, and Product, manage staffing tasks, and organize exercises that test our controls.
* **Maintain industry context** - Track relevant incidents, capabilities shifts, and research across frontier labs, and understand the key risks they reveal. Bring those lessons into our threat model, roadmap, and risk register.

**You may be a good fit if you:**
---------------------------------

* Have led company-wide technical programs, especially a company-wide security program, with multiple workstreams, executive sponsors, and other program managers rolling up to you.
* Have a strong background in at least one of the program's domains: agent or infrastructure security, ML classifiers and monitoring, evaluations, inference infrastructure, protecting an organization’s most sensitive data, or shipping security controls to customers. You know the terminology and can ramp up on the rest quickly.
* Have worked closely with ML research teams and understand how models are trained and evaluated.
* Work independently. You set direction without waiting for instructions and know when to make decisions and when to escalate.
* Can command a room and hold senior engineers, researchers, and executives accountable without formal authority.
* Write clearly and fast for any audience, from a one-page executive brief to a company-wide announcement.
* Use AI tools like Claude to automate tracking, reporting, and follow-up.
* Care about AI safety and want to help keep powerful systems under human oversight.

* Have 10+ years of experience in one of the aforementioned areas.

**Deadline to apply:** None, applications will be received on a rolling basis.

**Annual Salary:** TBD with Recruiting.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$365,000 - $435,000 USD

**Logistics**
-------------

**Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

**Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

**Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

**Location-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

**Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. We are seeking a highly capable, organized, and proactive professional to work directly with an entrepreneur who owns and operates multiple businesses across different industries and locations throughout the United States.

Our business interests include insurance, tax services, technology, professional services, media, and other developing ventures.

As our portfolio continues to grow, we are looking for someone who can help establish organization, coordinate operations, manage projects, and ensure important business initiatives consistently move forward.

This position combines elements of executive assistance, business operations, project management, and strategic coordination.

**We are not looking for someone who simply waits for instructions. We need a resourceful individual who can take initiative, solve problems, follow through, and take meaningful responsibilities off the business owner's plate.**

**Multi-Business Operations**

* Ensure deadlines, deliverables, and business objectives are consistently followed up on.

* Track assignments and follow up with employees, contractors, and service providers.

* Help manage email correspondence and follow-ups.
* Handle routine matters independently while escalating important decisions.
* Help the founder remain focused on growth, strategy, and high-level business decisions.

**Team & Vendor Coordination**

* Communicate with employees, managers, freelancers, and outside service providers across different locations.
* Track assignments, deliverables, and deadlines.
* Assist with hiring, onboarding, and coordinating personnel.
* Hold team members accountable for progress and completion.
* Improve communication and workflow between different businesses.

**Business Growth & Implementation**

* Assist with research, planning, and execution of new opportunities.
* Coordinate website, marketing, technology, and operational projects.
* Help implement new business systems, software, and automation.
* Assist with vendor comparisons, service sourcing, and other special projects.
* Help develop procedures that allow businesses to operate more independently.

Qualifications

* Experience in business operations, project management, executive assistance, or similar positions.
* Excellent organizational, multitasking, and communication skills.
* Strong independent problem-solving abilities.
* Experience managing multiple priorities, deadlines, and projects.
* Comfortable coordinating remote employees, contractors, and vendors.
* Proficient with modern business tools, project management software, and AI productivity applications.

Submit your resume along with a brief explanation of your experience supporting business owners, organizing multiple projects, or coordinating business operations.

new_jobs.description:
**Compensation:** $105,000 - $120,000

**Reports to:** Director of VBC Operations

**Direct Reports:** VBC Operations Coordinators and Patient Engagement Representative

**Location:** Remote (with the ability for limited travel to facility partners and team meetings)

**About Vitae Health Systems:**

Founded in 2018, Vitae Health Systems is one of the largest providers of behavioral health, internal medicine, and podiatry services to residents of Skilled Nursing and Assisted Living Facilities. Headquartered in Chicago, IL, we currently operate in over 10 states and are rapidly expanding throughout the USA.

**Overview**

Vitae launches its ACO under the CMS Long-term Enhanced ACO Design (LEAD) Model on January 1, 2027, building on our experience in ACO REACH High Needs. The VBC Program Manager builds and runs the operating rhythm of the LEAD ACO, making sure the work that drives results (beneficiary alignment, utilization, quality performance, and program compliance) is tracked, scheduled, and followed through on time.

This is a hands-on operating role. You will lead the VBC operations team, run the weekly and monthly performance cadence with the VBC data resource, and work with the VBC clinical team and operations managers to turn performance data into clear, prioritized actions. You own the calendar, the cadence, and the follow-through. Clinical standards and compliance decisions remain with clinical and compliance leadership.

**Key Responsibilities**

**LEAD ACO Operating Cadence and Performance Tracking**

* Run the weekly team huddle and monthly performance review covering alignment, utilization, quality, and reported spend, using KPIs and targets set by VBC leadership.
* Track performance against the LEAD quality measures and Prevention and Quality Plan milestones, and report variances to leadership.
* Monitor utilization drivers (admissions, readmissions, ED visits, post-acute stays) and confirm high-risk patients have a named owner and documented action, escalating gaps to clinical leadership.
* Review operational CMS reports and data feeds monthly, flag variances early, and escalate risks with a recommended path.
* Maintain the master calendar of CMS deadlines and deliverables, with a named owner for each, and follow up so nothing is missed.

**Alignment and Compliance Oversight**

* Oversee the voluntary alignment program against leadership-set targets and deadlines, including a documented pre-submission review before each CMS submission.
* Oversee reconciliation of CMS alignment lists to census and EHR data, and lead root cause reviews on avoidable attrition (deaths, hospice elections, moves, Medicare Advantage enrollment).
* Reconcile Participant and Preferred Provider lists to HR and credentialing records at the TIN/NPI level, escalating any change that needs a leadership or Compliance decision.
* Verify that beneficiary notifications and outreach activities are completed, tracked, and documented to CMS requirements, in partnership with Compliance.

**Cross-Functional Partnership**

* Work with operations managers on how VBC activities are scheduled and delivered at the facility and NP level, surfacing barriers early and avoiding unnecessary burden.
* Partner with VBC clinical leadership so workflows, checklists, and handoffs reflect clinical standards.
* Support development of provider-facing materials (scorecards, tip sheets, trainings) with the clinical and data owners, coordinating timelines and operational input.

**Data, Reporting & Continuous Improvement**

* Submit and sequence reporting requests to the VBC data resource through a single intake, review data for reasonableness before use in reviews, and flag manual work that could be automated.
* Prepare the performance summaries the Director of VBC Operations presents to senior leadership and ACO governance, aggregating data, clinical, and operational input.
* Lead root cause reviews when measures move off target and turn findings into action plans with named owners and due dates, tracking each to closure and routing clinical actions to clinical leadership.
* Facilitate a quarterly improvement cycle (plan, do, study, act) based on financial and performance results, with the Director of VBC Operations as sponsor: convene Finance, clinical, and data partners to select opportunities, assign actions, evaluate results, and document learning in a VBC operating playbook.

**Team Leadership**

* Lead the VBC operations team and serve as its first point of contact: coach, set priorities and escalation thresholds, build SOPs with process owners, and resolve operational questions and blockers within defined boundaries, escalating strategic, financial, compliance, and policy matters to the Director of VBC Operations.
* Provide input to the Director of VBC Operations on structure and staffing as scope grows.

**What Success Looks Like**

* **First 90 days**: The master CMS calendar is in place with named owners. The weekly and monthly cadence is running and escalation thresholds are defined. Alignment, quality, and utilization are tracked against targets all year, with action plans when a measure is off target. Escalations arrive with context and a recommended path.

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, public health, business, nursing, or a related field
* 4+ years in value-based care, ACO operations, or population health (provider-side strongly preferred)
* Direct experience in a CMS ACO model (ACO REACH, especially High Needs, MSSP, or LEAD)
* Experience in post-acute, SNF, or long-term care

**Position Overview**

We are seeking an experienced Sr. Project Manager / Business Analyst (PM/BA) with a strong understanding of manufacturing operations, warehouse management, distribution, supply chain processes, and global trade.

This individual will lead cross-functional projects from initiation through implementation while performing business analysis activities to evaluate processes, document requirements, identify opportunities for improvement, and support business and technology solutions.

The ideal candidate combines strong project management discipline with hands-on business analysis skills and a practical understanding of how manufacturing and supply chain operations function across an enterprise. This is a 100% remote position requiring excellent communication, organizational, analytical, and stakeholder management skills. 10% travel may be required.

**Remote Work Expectations**

This fully remote position requires effective collaboration with business and technical stakeholders across multiple locations and time zones. The successful candidate must be highly organized, self-directed, responsive, and comfortable facilitating virtual meetings, conducting remote process discovery, and managing deliverables without direct supervision.

* Understanding of value-based care/Alternative Payment Models, Medicare, and Non-MSSP quality measures
* Experience with statistical software, such as R or Stata

Kairos Power is a new nuclear energy technology and engineering company whose mission is to enable the world's transition to clean energy, with the ultimate goal to dramatically improve people's quality of life while protecting the environment. * Professional certifications such as Security+, CySA+, GSEC, SSCP, or similar are preferred.

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:**

* Working knowledge of networking principles, endpoint security, identity and access management, cloud services, and common cybersecurity controls.
* Working knowledge of security incident response principles and processes, including investigation, escalation, containment, remediation, recovery, and documentation.
